methods.label: Subtract three groups
methods.explanation:
Since \(97=100-3\), subtract three groups of \(103\) from one hundred groups of \(103\):
\[
103\times97=103(100-3)=10300-309=9991.
\]
The product is \(9991\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 4 distributive property and earlier whole-number multiplication.
